status.noDraft: No draft open — your next change opens one; the live app is not touched until you publish.
status.empty: Nothing published yet. Start with a table, or ask the assistant to build the app.
status.instanceOff: This app is switched off: its public API and automations are not running.

config.conflict: This draft was changed elsewhere (by a colleague or the assistant). It has been reloaded — please redo your change.
config.savedWithIssues: Saved to the draft, with {{count}} issue(s) to fix before publishing.

validate.valid: The draft is valid and can be published.
validate.invalid: The draft has {{count}} error(s); see the review before publishing.

discard.title: Discard draft r{{number}}?
discard.description: Every unpublished change in it is dropped. Its history stays, marked discarded; the live app is not affected.

publish.title: Publish draft r{{number}}
publish.description: What goes live, against the app as it runs now.
publish.destructive: Some changes may lose or reject existing data — deleted tables or fields, type changes, new constraints. They are marked below.

model.emptyHint: Add a table and its fields, or describe the app to the assistant and let it draft the model.
model.deleteHint: Removed from the draft, with what cannot exist without it. Existing records keep their data until you publish, and a rollback brings it back.

form.apiNameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _. Fixed once published.
form.enabledHint: A disabled table is not served or automated.
form.primaryHint: Shown wherever a record is referred to.
form.readOnlyHint: Every API refuses it; only automations set it.
form.hiddenHint: Never served on the public site.
form.uniqueIndexHint: No two records may share these values.
form.inverseHint: Lets the other table list these records; required for many-to-many.
form.optionsHint: One per line: value | label (the label is optional).

automation.deleteHint: The flow is removed from the draft; its run history stays.
automation.chain: Set off by the same action
automation.changedFields: Only when one of these changed
automation.conditionHint: An expression, e.g. row.amount >= 10000 && "status" in changedFields. Empty: always.
automation.stepsHint: A list of steps, each with an id, an action and its input; input values may hold template expressions. Actions: {{actions}}. Example:

events.manual: Run by hand or by another flow

access.title: What the public site may do
access.hint: Per table. Changes are part of the draft and go live when it is published.
access.apiHint: Revision {{revision}}. Signed-in site visitors own what they create.
access.notPublished: Publish the app to get a public API.
access.nothingPublic: No table is open to the site.

revisions.rollbackHint: Its configuration becomes live again as a new revision; the current one stays in the history.

records.conflict: The record was changed meanwhile; close and open it again.
records.deleteHint: Relationships pointing at it are handled as configured.
records.emptyHint: Records belong to the published tables. Publish the app's configuration first.
